name: van-joyforest-site
description: 靜態站。編輯 content/trip-stories/*.md 後請執行 npm run build 再部署，以更新 articles.json、各篇 HTML 與 sitemap。

scripts.build:en: node scripts/build-english-trip-stories.mjs && node scripts/inline-en-includes.mjs && node scripts/enhance-en-seo.mjs && node scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:en
scripts.seo:fix: node scripts/seo-sync.mjs && node scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs && node scripts/validate-seo.mjs
